title: Cloth Config API Forge
description: Configuration Library for Minecraft Mods (Unofficial Forge Port)
body:
Cloth Config API is a configuration screen API.

Fork of the [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config/) ported to newer Forge versions.
